content.title: Remote Monitoring That Moves Value-Based Contracts Forward
content.subtitle: Impilo supplies the connected devices, home logistics, data platform, and patient outreach that value-based teams need to keep members measured, engaged, and supported between visits.

content.title: Why Risk-Bearing Teams Rely on Impilo

items.title: Members rarely report readings on their own
items.text: Cellular devices send each measurement automatically, so care managers see trends without chasing members for numbers.

items.title: Outreach teams are stretched thin
items.text: Our specialists handle setup calls, reminders, and troubleshooting, freeing your staff to focus on members who need clinical attention.

items.title: Supply logistics distract from care goals
items.text: We stock, pack, and ship kits nationwide, then manage returns and replacements without adding work for your operations team.

items.title: Data from different vendors never lines up
items.text: Readings arrive in one consistent format that feeds your reporting, attribution, and quality workflows.

content.title: Everything a Value-Based Program Needs to Monitor Members at Home

cards.subtitle: Patient-Ready Devices & RPM Setup
cards.title: Devices That Arrive Configured and Ready for the First Reading
cards.text: Every kit is assembled, tested, and labeled before it ships, so members can start measuring the day it arrives.

cards.subtitle: Monitoring & Patient Coordination Tools
cards.title: One Workspace for Alerts, Outreach, and Time Tracking
cards.text: Care teams review readings, message members, and log monitoring time in a single place built for program operations.

cards.subtitle: At-Home Labs & Diagnostics
cards.title: Lab Collection Kits Delivered and Returned Without Extra Effort
cards.text: We coordinate shipping, instructions, and sample returns, then route results back to your team for follow-up.

cards.subtitle: Data Connectivity & Intelligent Insights
cards.title: Population Views That Highlight Members Who Need Attention
cards.text: Standardized device data rolls up into trend views that help teams prioritize outreach across attributed populations.

cards.subtitle: And Much More
cards.title: From branded packaging to custom reporting, we shape services around the goals of your value-based program

items: Higher monitoring adherence through ready-to-use devices and proactive member support.
Earlier visibility into rising risk with consistent, timely readings from every member.
Lower operating overhead by consolidating devices, logistics, and outreach with one partner.
Cleaner reporting for quality programs thanks to standardized data across device vendors.
More time for clinicians to focus on members who need hands-on care.
